90/* Sub block ID: 0x01C0, ICD API: AWR_MONITOR_RF_DIG_LATENTFAULT_CONF_SB */
91/* DesignId : MMWL_DesignId_073 */
92/* Requirements : AUTORADAR_REQ-768, AUTORADAR_REQ-1131 */
93rlReturnVal_t rlRfDigMonEnableConfig(rlUInt8_t deviceMap, rlMonDigEnables_t* data)
94{
95 rlReturnVal_t retVal;
96
97 /* check if deviceIndex is out of defined value */
98 if ((rlDriverIsDeviceMapValid(deviceMap) != RL_RET_CODE_OK) || (RL_NULL_PTR == data))
99 {
100 /* set return error code */
101 retVal = RL_RET_CODE_INVALID_INPUT;
102 }
103 else
104 {
105 /* Package the command with given data and send it to device */
106 retVal = rlDriverExecuteSetApi(deviceMap, RL_RF_MONITORING_CONF_SET_MSG,
107 RL_RF_DIG_MON_EN_SB, (rlUInt8_t*)data,
108 (rlUInt16_t)sizeof(rlMonDigEnables_t));
109 }
110 return retVal;
111}

384/* Sub block ID: 0x01C7, ICD API: AWR_MONITOR_TX0_POWER_CONF_SB */
385/* Sub block ID: 0x01C8, ICD API: AWR_MONITOR_TX1_POWER_CONF_SB */
386/* Sub block ID: 0x01C9, ICD API: AWR_MONITOR_TX2_POWER_CONF_SB */
387/* DesignId : MMWL_DesignId_080 */
388/* Requirements : AUTORADAR_REQ-861 */
389rlReturnVal_t rlRfTxPowrMonConfig(rlUInt8_t deviceMap, rlAllTxPowMonConf_t *data)
390{
391 rlReturnVal_t retVal;
392 /* Initialize Command and Response Sub Blocks */
393 rlDriverMsg_t inMsg;
394 rlDriverMsg_t outMsg = {0};
395 rlUInt16_t numSbc = 0U;
396
397 /* Initialize Command and Response Sub Blocks */
398 rlPayloadSb_t inPayloadSb[RL_MAX_SB_IN_MSG] = {0};
399
400 RL_LOGV_ARG0("rlRfTxPowrMonConfig starts...\n");
401
402 /* Construct command packet */
403 rlDriverConstructInMsg(RL_RF_MONITORING_CONF_SET_MSG, &inMsg, &inPayloadSb[0U]);
404
405 /* check if deviceIndex is out of defined value */
406 if ((rlDriverIsDeviceMapValid(deviceMap) != RL_RET_CODE_OK) || \
407 (RL_NULL_PTR == data))
408 {
409 retVal = RL_RET_CODE_INVALID_INPUT;
410 RL_LOGE_ARG0("rlRfTxPowrMonConfig, Invalid input \n");
411 }
412 else
413 {
414 /* check for NULL pointer */
415 if ((RL_NULL_PTR != data->tx0PowrMonCfg))
416 {
417 /* Fill in-message Payload */
418 rlDriverFillPayload(RL_RF_MONITORING_CONF_SET_MSG,
419 RL_RF_TX0_POW_MON_CONF_SB,
420 &inPayloadSb[numSbc],
421 (rlUInt8_t* )data->tx0PowrMonCfg,
422 (rlUInt16_t)sizeof(rlTxPowMonConf_t));
423 numSbc++;
424 }
425 /* check for NULL pointer */
426 if ((RL_NULL_PTR != data->tx1PowrMonCfg))
427 {
428 /* Fill in-message Payload */
429 rlDriverFillPayload(RL_RF_MONITORING_CONF_SET_MSG,
430 RL_RF_TX1_POW_MON_CONF_SB,
431 &inPayloadSb[numSbc],
432 (rlUInt8_t* )data->tx1PowrMonCfg,
433 (rlUInt16_t)sizeof(rlTxPowMonConf_t));
434 numSbc++;
435 }
436 /* check for NULL pointer */
437 if ((RL_NULL_PTR != data->tx2PowrMonCfg))
438 {
439 /* Fill in-message Payload */
440 rlDriverFillPayload(RL_RF_MONITORING_CONF_SET_MSG,
441 RL_RF_TX2_POW_MON_CONF_SB,
442 &inPayloadSb[numSbc],
443 (rlUInt8_t* )data->tx2PowrMonCfg,
444 (rlUInt16_t)sizeof(rlTxPowMonConf_t));
445 numSbc++;
446 }
447
448 if (numSbc > 0U)
449 {
450 /* setting num of sub-block to inMsg */
451 inMsg.opcode.nsbc = numSbc;
452
453 /* Send Command to mmWave Radar Device */
454 retVal = rlDriverCmdInvoke(deviceMap, inMsg, &outMsg);
455 }
456 else
457 {
458 retVal = RL_RET_CODE_INVALID_INPUT;
459 RL_LOGE_ARG0("sub block is NULL\n");
460 }
461 }
462
463 return retVal;
464}
